name: What are the standard stages of a general contracting construction project?
description: Projects progress through pre-construction planning, structural work and rough-ins, finish installations, and a final inspection and owner walk-through.

mainEntity.name: What are the standard stages of a general contracting construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The general contracting process moves through pre-construction, site preparation, rough construction, interior finishes, and the final walk-through. Pre-construction involves reviewing blueprints, finalizing budgets, signing contracts, and acquiring local building permits. Once construction begins, the job progresses sequentially: demolition and foundation work occur first, followed by framing, rough-in mechanicals (HVAC, plumbing, electrical), insulation, and drywall. After walls are closed, finishes like cabinetry, flooring, fixtures, and paint are completed. The process concludes with a punch-list walk-through with the property owner and passing the final municipal inspection to receive a certificate of occupancy.
